prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Creating Your Desktop Companion", "Analyzing preferences and model", "Rendering desktop sprite animations"]
1: ["Sign In to Save Progress", "Sync your account early so your pet selection and custom creations are saved safely."]
2: ["Choose Your Journey", "Select whether to adopt an instant ready-made desktop pet or upload photos to generate a custom companion.", "Ready-made or Custom Creation", "Continue to Path Selection"]
3: ["Welcome Your Pet to the Desktop!", "Your companion is ready! Click below to summon it onto your desktop screen.", "Release Pet to Desktop"]
4: ["Sign In to Access Your Pets", "Use your existing account to restore all previously adopted desktop companions and settings automatically.", "Make sure to sign in with the same email or provider you used previously."]
5: ["Unsure? You can always create or adopt additional pets later from your desktop menu."]
6: ["We'll Notify You When Ready", "Feel free to minimize this window. We will send a desktop notification as soon as your pet is generated."]
7: ["Tip: Right-click your pet anytime on the desktop to hide, move, or chat with it."]
8: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "For best results, upload high-resolution, front-facing photos with good lighting."]
9: ["Pick Your Companion & Claim Bonus", "Includes Free Starter Toy Pack"]
